bullets: Added the /reasoning slash command (also available as /effort and /think) to the Freebuff CLI, which opens the model's reasoning-effort picker directly from chat.
Added a recovery flow for BYOK connection locks so a process killed mid-update no longer leaves a stuck lock; a live owning PID is detected before the lock is taken over.
Tagged Freebuff Desktop traffic with its own surface label so Desktop clicks and conversions are no longer attributed to the CLI for signed-in users.
Added a trust gate that also checks remote agents listing MCP servers, refusing unpublished publisher templates that define external tools unless the publisher is trusted.
Added a 50/50 per-user experiment arm for precomputed ad scores that randomly assigns users to receive ranked ads based on precomputed scores or the existing ranking order.
Added the /reasoning slash command to the Freebuff CLI, which opens a reasoning-effort picker so users can select how deeply a model thinks before responding.
Added Solar Mini 4 to the standing $5 offer schedule with a free weekend window on Oct 2 at price 0 and a return to the paid price on Oct 5.
Tagged Freebuff Desktop usage with a dedicated surface label so Desktop traffic is no longer attributed to the CLI for signed-in users.
Added a trust check that also covers agents connecting to external tools (MCP servers), refusing unpublished publisher templates that list them unless the publisher is trusted.
Added a 50/50 stickiness experiment arm for precomputed ad scores that assigns half of users to receive ads ranked by precomputed scores.
Added the /reasoning slash command (also /effort and /think) to the Freebuff CLI, which opens the reasoning-effort picker for the current model.
Added a lock-recovery flow for BYOK connections so a process killed while taking a lock can no longer leave an unrecoverable lock behind.
Scheduled three new Solar Mini 4 price points: a standing $5 offer starting Sep 23, a free window on Oct 2, and a return to regular price on Oct 5.
Added a trust gate that treats MCP servers listed by a remote agent template as executable content, refusing untrusted publisher templates that define them.
Added a 50/50 per-user experiment arm for precomputed ad scores that routes half of users to ads ranked by precomputed model output.
Added the /reasoning slash command to the Freebuff CLI, which opens the reasoning-effort picker for the current model directly from the chat input.
